column1: # Rows are MODULE-granular for in-scope code and subsystem-granular for what is ignored.
# Anything under agent/ or tools/ without a row here is implicitly OUT_OF_SCOPE. Tracking
# whole subsystems made the drift report useless: agent/ and tools/ are 266k lines and only
# ~38k of that is in scope, so staleness was dominated by code that will never be written.
# See SCOPE.md for the reasoning and REQUIREMENTS.md for the evidence.
# ported_from = upstream RELEASE TAG this was implemented against ("-" = nothing yet).
#   NOT_STARTED  - in scope, no implementation yet
#   PORTED       - implemented against the recorded tag
#   STALE        - computed, never written by hand (upstream moved past the recorded tag)
#   REFERENCE    - read for ideas, deliberately not ported; drift is worth knowing, not fixing
#   OUT_OF_SCOPE - deliberately not being built; upstream drift here is irrelevant
# Deliberately tag-granular, not commit-granular: upstream lands ~1100 commits/month but only
# ~2 releases. Tags are the review unit; drill to commits only when actually implementing.
